text: In 1998, Microsoft showed off Windows 98 live, on stage, with Bill Gates watching. The new trick was "plug and play": connect a device and Windows finds the right driver automatically. They plugged in a scanner. The screen turned blue. A driver runs deep inside the system. If it does something illegal, Windows stops everything instantly, before it can damage your data. That's the blue screen of death. Gates said: "That must be why we're not shipping Windows 98 yet."
